headline: Vr Infraspace wins Rs 1.45 crore road work order from Rajkot Panchayat R&B
summary: Confirmed order for Shelana-Jejad road improvement. Book-to-bill context limited due to zero TTM revenue in filings, though FY26 revenue was Rs 76.50 Cr.

headline: Vinyas wins Rs 39.96 cr order for helicopter helmets
summary: Vinyas Innovative Technologies secured a Rs 39.96 crore work order for helicopter helmet supply and replacement. The order represents significant inflow against recent quarterly revenue trends, with execution spanning 8-9 months.

headline: Jubilant Foodworks Q2FY27 revenue up 11.9% YoY
summary: Jubilant Foodworks posted consolidated revenue of ₹2,608.7 crore in Q2FY27, up 11.9% YoY. Domino's India recorded like-for-like growth of 4.1% during the quarter.

headline: Matrimony.com Q2FY26 billings up 10.7% YoY
summary: Matrimony.com reported Q2FY26 consolidated billings of ₹13,109 lakhs, up 10.7% YoY. H1FY26 billings stood at ₹26,711 lakhs, reflecting 9.2% YoY growth.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Om Power, Ola Electric, Tata Steel in focus
summary: Om Power rallies 8% on GETCO order; Ola Electric ticks up ahead of rights issue; Tata Steel slips on Q2 results. Check key triggers.

headline: Muthoot Microfin Q2FY27: AUM up 22% YoY
summary: Muthoot Microfin reported 22% YoY growth in AUM to ₹15,323 crore in Q2FY27. Cost of funds dropped to single digits at 9.93%, while disbursements rose 28% YoY.

headline: Kotak Mahindra MF sells Mphasis shares
summary: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund disposed of 123,216 equity shares of Mphasis Ltd in the open market on October 5, 2026, reducing its holding to 7.237%.

headline: Bajaj Consumer Care Q2FY27 earnings call set for Oct 15
summary: Bajaj Consumer Care will host an analyst conference call on October 15, 2026, to discuss its unaudited financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.

headline: Blue Cloud Softech signs MoU with Senegal govt
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions Ltd has signed a non-binding MoU with Senegal's Ministry of Telecommunications and GCIB for Africa to support digital transformation and infrastructure.

headline: ITC block trade: ~36.5 crore shares at ₹265.30
summary: A block trade of ~365,473,609 ITC shares was executed on BSE at ₹265.30 per share, aggregating to ₹9,696.01 crore.

headline: Rupee opens stronger at 96.6825 against dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 96.6825 against the US dollar, strengthening from the previous close of 96.7750, reflecting a marginal gain in the domestic currency.

headline: Karamtara Engineering targets 60-65% revenue growth in FY27
summary: Karamtara Engineering aims for 60% to 65% revenue growth in FY27, with Q2 showing strong progress. The company expects 40% to 42% of revenue in H1 and 58% to 60% in H2.
